name: The /wait-what Skill
summary: A three-line agent skill that makes a coding agent re-pitch what it just said in plain English when you get lost.
description: Page for the /wait-what skill in Matt Pocock's skills collection: you type /wait-what when a message lost you, and the agent re-pitches the explanation in plain English, reusing the vocabulary from your project's GLOSSARY.md. Installed with npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill=wait-what; it is part of the AI Skills for Real Engineers series on aihero.dev.
contains: three-line skill that re-pitches the last explanation
